name: Depraved Town
source:
In Depraved Town, you wake up discovering that you made a deal with a Succubus, an agreement where both sides win, you can corrupt and have any woman you want, and she grows stronger with the corruption you cause. However, not everything will be easy. During your journey, other men like you will try to interfere, and in time, you will discover the true nature of your contract and its consequences around it.​

[From Patreon]
